title: T.I.M.E Stories
subtitle: Deck-Exploration Time Travel Agency Campaign
tagline: Project your consciousness into historical receptacles and fix dangerous quantum paradoxes before time runs out.
loreSummary: The T.I.M.E Agency protects humanity by preventing temporal faults and paradoxes that threaten the space-time continuum. As tactical temporal agents, project your minds into historical host bodies—receptacles—to investigate mysteries, solve puzzles, and preserve the integrity of history across multiple iterative runs.
keyFeatures: Pioneering deck-exploring system where panoramic panorama cards depict immersive rooms and locations
Time Unit (TU) expenditure clock: each action spends precious time, forcing tactical loop optimization
Branching narrative mystery with cryptic clues, locked passages, tests, and character-specific interactions
Modular system: the base game includes the acclaimed 1921 Paris 'Asylum' scenario

time_stories_asylum_mission.name: Mission 1: Asylum Temporal Resolution (3 Runs)
time_stories_asylum_mission.description: The definitive base scenario experience resolving the 1921 Parisian asylum anomaly across 3 iterative loop runs.

time_stories_first_loop.name: First Temporal Transfer & Recon (1 Run)
time_stories_first_loop.description: An introductory reconnaissance loop learning the asylum layout and identifying key staff suspects.

time_stories_agency_quadrilogy.name: The Agency White Cycle Quadrilogy (12 Runs)
time_stories_agency_quadrilogy.description: An extensive multi-mission campaign through the core White Cycle scenarios (Asylum, The Marcy Case, A Prophecy of Dragons).

milestones.title: Tachyon Insertion: 1921 Paris
milestones.description: Transferring agency consciousness into patient receptacles inside the Roaring Twenties French psychiatric asylum.

milestones.title: Unraveling the Temporal Tear
milestones.description: Leveraging memories from previous temporal loops to bypass lethal security traps and unlock the basement crypt.

milestones.title: Closing the Quantum Paradox
milestones.description: Confronting the temporal anomaly source before Time Units expire and reporting back to T.I.M.E Agency debriefing.
